intro: Technology and government sectors bore the brunt of 51 ai-security tagged articles published between April 12 and April 30, 2026. The coverage featured threat actors Claude Mythos and OpenClaw, alongside critical vulnerabilities CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) and CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3). Affected regions included Global, China, and the United states. The severity mix comprised 23 high, 7 critical, 6 medium, and 12 informational reports, highlighting persistent risks across cybersecurity, healthcare, and artificial intelligence domains.
